                i = 0;
            }
            i++;
        }

        s = sc.nextLine();

        Pattern underscore = Pattern.compile("_+");
        s = underscore.matcher(s).replaceAll(" ").trim();

        StringBuilder inside = new StringBuilder();
        int mode = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
            char c = s.charAt(i);
            switch (c) {
                case '(':
                    mode = 1;
                    break;
                case ')':
                    inside.append(' ');
                    mode = 0;
                    break;
                default:
                    if (mode == 1) inside.append(c);
                    break;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
            if (s.charAt(i) == ')') {
                int open = s.indexOf('(');
                s = s.substring(0, open) + " " + s.substring(i + 1);
                i = 0;
            }
        }

        Pattern spaces = Pattern.compile(" +");
        s = spaces.matcher(s).replaceAll(" ").trim();
        String insideText = spaces.matcher(inside.toString()).replaceAll(" ").trim();

        String[] out = s.split(" ");
        String[] in = insideText.split(" ");

        int max = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < out.length; i++) {
            if (out[i].length() > max) max = out[i].length();
        }

        if (!insideText.equals("") && !insideText.equals(" ")) {
            System.out.println(max + " " + in.length);
        } else {
            System.out.println(max + " " + "0");
        }
    }
}
